title: International Postgraduate Diploma in Strategic Management (Level 7)
description: The International Postgraduate Diploma in Strategic Management is designed to provide in-depth knowledge and understanding of the various aspect of strategic management...
longDescription: Aim of the Programme: The International Postgraduate Diploma in Strategic Management is designed to provide in-depth knowledge and understanding of the various aspect of strategic management within the organisational context. It provides a rich collaborative learning experience where learner exchange views with other participants, interact with research-active tutors and are challenged to become reflective managers. The International Postgraduate Diploma in Strategic Management also provides learners with realistic and appropriate career-related guidance for early 21st-century employment markets. Programme Structure This program consists of 6 compulsory units, which are equal to a total of 120 credits.
courseDetails: 7 source-listed curriculum sections and 102 lesson or resource entries are included below.
entry: An honours degree in a related subject or the UK level 6 diploma or equivalent overseas qualification, i.e. bachelor's Degree or Higher National Diploma
Mature learners (over 25) with at least five years of management experience if they do not possess the above qualification (this is reviewed on a case-by-case basis)
For entry onto theInternational Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Strategic Management qualification, learners must possess:
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up Upon completing this course, students can complete a Master's degree programme from one of our Partner Universities. The top-up programme can be studied online. The top-up may comprise the study of a few modules or a final dissertation project. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) For more details and partner Universities offering the topup, please speak to our student advisors.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive an International Postgraduate Diploma from GSS and awarding partners.
